mcp.name: Name
mcp.description_hint: Default: site title from config.ini. Can help the model to place the server.
mcp.tools_hint: Tools are actions an AI client can call. The model reads title, description and parameter descriptions – they influence whether and how it searches.
mcp.parked_hint: disabled – stays parked in the file
mcp.title: Title
mcp.title_hint: for humans, e.g. in the tool list
mcp.tool_description: Description (helps decide when the model uses the tool)
mcp.resources_hint: Resources are contents a client fetches by URI – here a single record via catalog://record/{recordId}. The URI is defined in the PHP code.
mcp.content_types_hint: Each content type is a Solr filter. Tools with the parameter contentType offer the checked content types to the model. “Check” counts the matching records in the index.
mcp.response_fields_hint: The model receives these fields for every hit. More fields = more context, but also more text in the model's context window.
mcp.hint_host: (Host header rejected? Use a localhost public_url, see README)
mcptest.title: MCP test
mcptest.nav_label: Call tools like an AI client
mcptest.intro: The GUI talks to the MCP server exactly like an AI client: initialize → tools/list → tools/call. What you see below is what a model gets to see.
mcptest.no_tools: No tools – enable or create them in the MCP editor.
mcptest.tools_raw: tools/list raw – exactly this description is read by the model
mcptest.no_results_link: No link to the full result list (search_results_page) in the answer.
mcptest.filter_missing: The link does not contain the content type filter “{type}”. The result list in VuFind is therefore broader than what the model received.
mcptest.raw_answer: Raw answer ({n} characters – this much text goes to the model)
ranking.directives: The local file uses {list}. The editor cannot represent that – please edit the raw text.
ranking.comments_lost: The local file contains own comments. Saving via the editor loses them (a backup is created).
ranking.no_solr: No Solr URL configured: field statistics and preview are unavailable.
ranking.intro: Set which fields VuFind searches and how much a hit in each field counts. Only search types that differ from the original are saved – VuFind inherits all others automatically.
ranking.saved_removed: No differences left – local copy removed, the original applies.
ranking.queryfields_hint: This search type uses QueryFields (Lucene syntax with “munge” rules). It is used for advanced search, browsing and IDs. Please edit it as raw text.
ranking.exact_hint: If someone puts the whole search in quotes, VuFind can use other fields – typically unstemmed fields for exact matches.
ranking.preview_title: Preview: how does the order change?
ranking.preview_hint: Sends the same request as VuFind directly to Solr – once with the saved and once with the edited settings. Updates with every change.
ranking.enter_terms: Enter search terms to see the result list.
ranking.type_AllFields: The default search “All fields” – affects almost every catalog search and the MCP server.
ranking.type_JournalTitle: Journal title – with a fixed filter on journals and articles.
ranking.not_in_index_title: Field not in the index or not searchable
ranking.empty_field_title: No record has this field – the weight currently has no effect
ranking.boost_hint: Boost = factor for hits in this field, empty = 1. What matters is the ratio of the weights. “_unstemmed” fields only find the exact word form, the others also base forms.
ranking.fq_hint: Applied additionally to every search of this type.
ranking.handler_hint: edismax understands AND/OR/NOT, * and field search directly; dismax switches to QueryFields for those.
ranking.param_mm: Minimum number of matching search words, e.g. 100% or 2<-1. VuFind default: edismax 0 % (AND comes from q.op=AND), dismax 100 %.
ranking.param_tie: 0 to 1: how much hits in further fields count. 0 = only the best field, 1 = sum of all fields.
ranking.param_pf: Phrase fields: bonus if all search words appear right after each other in the field, e.g. “title_full^200”.
ranking.param_pf2: Like pf, but for each word pair.
ranking.param_pf3: Like pf, but for each word triple.
ranking.param_ps: Phrase slop for pf: how many words may stand in between.
ranking.param_qs: Slop for phrases users type in “…” themselves.
ranking.param_bq: Boost query, e.g. “format:Book^5” – matching records move up.
ranking.param_bf: Boost function, e.g. recency: recip(rord(publishDateSort),1,1000,1000). In VuFind's default schema publishDateSort is a text field (year), so ms() does not work with it.
ranking.cond_AllSearchTypesIn: all search types of the search in this list
ranking.cond_NoDismaxParams: only if the search type does not set these parameters itself
ranking.cond_SortIn: only with this sorting (e.g. score desc)
ranking.global_title: Extra parameters for all search types
ranking.global_hint: GlobalExtraParams add Solr parameters to searches – e.g. a bonus for newer records. Conditions restrict them to certain search types or sortings. The preview uses the search type AllFields.
ranking.unsupported_queryfields: This search type only uses QueryFields (Lucene syntax). The preview only covers dismax search types.
ranking.unsupported_dismax_syntax: With dismax and advanced syntax (AND/OR/*/…) VuFind switches to QueryFields – the preview does not cover that.
